SUBFACTORS FROM BRAIDED C∗TENSOR CATEGORIES
JULIANA ERLIJMAN AND HANS WENZL
We extend subfactor constructions originally deﬁned for unitary braid rep-
resentations to the setting of braided C∗-tensor categories. The categorical
approach is then used to compute the principal graph of these subfactors.
We also determine the dual principal graph for several important cases.
